title: What Would You Trust AI to Do for You
paragraphs: Artificial intelligence (AI) can now help with many tasks. But what would people really trust AI to do for them? A new survey in the United States asked this question.
The survey was carried out by YouGov in June 2026. It asked 1,126 American adults which jobs they would let AI do without a human checking its work.

Many people did not want AI to do important or dangerous jobs on its own. For example, 65% said they definitely would not let AI fly a passenger plane. Also, 57% would not let AI drive them and their family on the highway, and 55% would not let AI decide whether they got a job.

However, some people were more comfortable with other tasks. About 28% said they would let AI negotiate the price of a big purchase. Another 28% would let AI answer their phone calls and messages for them, and 25% would let AI approve a loan.

The survey also asked parents about their children. Most parents did not want AI to be their child's main friend. About 69% said they definitely would not allow this. But 46% said they would let AI watch their child's phone and messages and warn them about problems. About 40% of parents would let AI teach their child school subjects.
People who use AI every day trusted it much more. For example, 52% of daily users would let AI negotiate a purchase. In contrast, only 8% of people who never use AI said the same.
The survey also found that 10% of Americans say they have an ongoing friendship with an AI chatbot. Among adults under 30, the figure was 18%.
